integrity.claim_scope: One theorem giving the exact projective-dual degree profile and all fixed-degree-sum maximizers for codimension-two complete-intersection threefolds.
integrity.computational_role: Exact finite regression checks through q=2000; no finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.
integrity.source_date_note: The 1977-01-01 date is the dated bibliographic record for Kleiman’s chapter that contains the dual-class formula used here.

scientific_limitations: Restricted to smooth complex codimension-two complete-intersection threefolds \(X_{d,e}\subset\mathbb P^5\) with \(d,e\ge2\).
The originality conclusion is bounded by the inspected sources and searches; an equivalent fixed-degree-sum extremal statement may exist under different terminology.
The finite checker is regression evidence only; the all-\(q\) result rests on the symbolic completed-square proof.
title: Square-root imbalance maximizes dual degree for codimension-two complete-intersection threefolds
